description:
What the connected Refora organization's plan includes (workspaces, tracked questions, AI models, how often they run) and what each workspace is measured with: its own tracking, a market snapshot, or nothing yet. Includes a link to set up tracking and one to the plans.

Use this tool when the user asks what their plan covers, why a number comes from market data, or how to track their own questions -- phrases like 'what's included', 'can you track this weekly', 'how do I add my own questions'.

Example question: 'What does my Refora plan include?'
name: get_account
title: Account and plan
